lines: Now I'm racing across the blue horizon
Feeling the flow of time, sharpened and clear
Ah, the world is starting to move toward this thrill
The arrival of a far-off dream I'd nearly forgotten
Ride On Time, if these are my wandering longings
Take them in gently, wrap them up softly, oh
Ride On Time, light a fire in my heart
Spread wide into this overflowing joy, Ride On Time
My shining future, now begin to turn
Even my empty days all melt into love
Ah, what a morning — right now, to where you are
I'll carry it to you, my burning heart without hesitation
Ride On Time, time, start running
Love, shine out, till it dazzles the eyes, oh
Ride On Time, light a fire in my heart
I send it to my soul as it takes flight, Ride On Time
Ah, I'll carry it to you, my burning heart, now more than ever, oh
